$comment: Trusted Types sinks in the web bundle and why each is acceptable. Checked by packages/csp/bin/bundle-sinks.mjs; see docs/trusted-types-plan.md.

sinks.DOMParser.parseFromString npm:@tiptap/co: elementFromString (setContent, insertContent): an inert document; the plain string goes through the default policy.
sinks.DOMParser.parseFromString npm:dompurify: DOMPurify's own parse, given TrustedHTML from its own 'dompurify' policy, which the header allows.
sinks.DOMParser.parseFromString npm:tiptap-mar: elementFromString for HTML rendered from markdown: an inert document; the plain string goes through the default policy.
sinks.DOMParser.parseFromString packages/csp/s: The default policy's comparison parse, given TrustedHTML from hangar-inert.
sinks.DOMParser.parseFromString packages/utils: parseInertHTML, the one parse of our own, given TrustedHTML from hangar-inert.
sinks.dangerouslySetInnerHTML npm:jsx-dom-cjs: jsx-dom's support for the prop; the table view built with jsx-dom does not use it. Any use would go through the default policy.
sinks.dangerouslySetInnerHTML npm:next-themes: The anti-flash script. The copy that runs is the one served in the document, allowed by hash or nonce; React's client re-render does not execute and the default policy recognises it (KNOWN_LIBRARY_SCRIPTS).
sinks.dangerouslySetInnerHTML npm:react-dom: React's implementation of the prop; its callers are the other dangerouslySetInnerHTML entries here.
sinks.dangerouslySetInnerHTML npm:react-router: <Scripts>' inline context and module loader: served in the document and allowed by hash (web, admin) or nonce (space); client re-renders go through the default policy.
sinks.eval npm:decimal.js-light: Function('return this') global detection, never reached in a browser (globalThis exists); refused anyway by script-src, which has no 'unsafe-eval'.
sinks.eval npm:lodash: Function('return this') global detection, never reached in a browser (globalThis exists); refused anyway by script-src, which has no 'unsafe-eval'.
sinks.eval npm:lodash-es: Function('return this') global detection, never reached in a browser (globalThis exists); refused anyway by script-src, which has no 'unsafe-eval'.
sinks.innerHTML npm:@bprogress/core: The progress bar's constant template; goes through the default policy, which DOMPurify leaves unchanged.
sinks.innerHTML npm:@tiptap/core: createStyleTag, which never runs: every editor is created with injectCSS: false.
sinks.innerHTML npm:decode-named-character-ref: Decodes an '&name;' entity for the markdown renderer on a detached element; goes through the default policy.
sinks.innerHTML npm:dompurify: DOMPurify's own parse, given TrustedHTML from its own 'dompurify' policy.
sinks.innerHTML npm:element-resize-detector: Constant markup of the resize sensor used by the stickies masonry; goes through the default policy.
sinks.innerHTML npm:highlight.js: highlightElement, not on our code path (code blocks use lowlight); any use would go through the default policy.
sinks.innerHTML npm:jsx-dom-cjs: jsx-dom's HTML prop support, unused by the table view; any use would go through the default policy.
sinks.innerHTML npm:prosemirror-view: The clipboard parser (readHTML) into a detached document; ProseMirror hands it to the default policy itself.
sinks.innerHTML npm:react-dom: dangerouslySetInnerHTML and React's inert creation of script elements; plain strings go through the default policy.
sinks.innerHTML npm:tiptap-markdown: Reformats HTML rendered from markdown on inert elements; goes through the default policy.
sinks.script element npm:react-dom: React creates script elements for rendered and hoisted scripts; client-rendered ones do not execute, and script text or URLs go through the default policy.
